senses.gloss:
नि-शामन (नं) 1.
n. Sight, behold-
ing; hearing; a shadow.

निशा-चर (रः) 1.
m. A
Rākshasa;
an imp, a ghost, owl, a snake, a
thief, a jackal.
f. (री) A whore;
a friend.
a. Nocturnal.

निशाद (दः) 1.
m. A man of a low caste.

नि-षाद (दः) 1.
m. The highest of
the seven musical notes; an out-
cast; a fisherman.

निशादत्व (त्व) 1.
n. State of a low caste.

निशा_न्त (न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
a. Quiet, tranquil.
n. A house; break of day.

निशारुक (कं) 1.
n. Air of a tune.

नि-शित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Sharpened,
whetted.
n. Iron.

निशि-पुष्पा (ष्पा) 1.
f. A flower (Nyc-
tanthes tristis).

नि-शुम्भ (म्भः) 1.
m. Killing; a giant
killed by
Durgā.

निश्च_ल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Immoveable,
fixed.
f. The earth.

निश्चला_ङ्ग (ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
a. Firm.
m. A
crane; a rock, mountain.

नि-श्चारक (कः) 1.
m. Evacuation by
stool; wind; obstinacy.

नि-श्चित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Ascertained;
sentenced.
n. Certainty.

नि-श्चुक्कण (णं) 1.
n. A kind of tooth powder.

निश्श्रेयस-कर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Confer-
ring final bliss or emancipation.

निश्-श्वसन (नं) 1.
n. Breathing out,
sighing, breathing hard.

नि-षङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. A quiver; union,
meeting, association.

नि-षङ्गथि (थिः) 2.
m. Embracing,
an embrace, union; a bowman
or archer; a charioteer; a car;
grass; the shoulder.

नि-षण्णक (कः)
a. Seated.
n. A seat.

नि-षद्या (द्या) 1.
f. A market; a
small bed or a cot.

नि-षध (धः) 1.
m. Name of a moun-
tain; of a country; of a king;
name of a musical note.

नि-षन्नक (कः) 1.
m. A sort of potherb.

नि-षादिन् (दी) 5.
m. An elephant
keeper or driver.

नि-षीदत् (न्-न्ती-त्)
p. Sitting; stand-
ing, resting on.

नि-षेक (कः) 1.
m. Sprinkling; a cere-
mony after conception; effusion.

नि-षेध (धः) 1.
m. Prohibition, pre-
vention, stop; exception to rule.

नि-षेवनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That should
be served, or practised.

निष्क् (ङ, क) निष्कयते 10.
d. To mea-
sure or weigh.

निष्क (ष्कः-ष्कं) 1.
m. n. A eight of
gold; a golden ornament.

निष्क-कण्ठ (ण्ठः-ण्ठी-ण्ठं)
a. Wearing a
necklace of gold.

नि-ष्कण्टक (कः-का-कं)
a. Without
thorns or trouble.

नि-ष्कण्ठ (ण्ठः) 1.
m. A plant (Capa-
ris trifoliata).

नि-ष्कर्म्मन् (र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
a. Without
work; neglecting works.

नि-ष्कल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Waned; im-
potent; full, without parts (God).
m. Pudendum muliebre;
Brahmā.
f. A woman past child-bearing.

नि-ष्काम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Without wish-
ing.
n. Involuntarily.

नि-ष्कारुष (षः-षा-षं)
a. Of a noble race.

नि-ष्कालक (कः) 1.
m. A penitent
shaved and smeared^1 with
ghī.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

नि-ष्कासिन् (सी-सिनी-सि)
a. Expelling.
f. A female slave not restrained.

नि-ष्कुट (टः) 1.
m. A grove near a
house; a field; a door; pri-
vate apartment; the
Zenāna. f.
(टा-टिः-टी) Large cardamoms.

नि-ष्कुह (हः) 1.
m. Hollow of a tree.

नि-ष्कृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Undone; par-
doned; neglected, negligent.

नि-ष्कृति (तिः) 2.
f. Undoing; par-
don; neglect; acquittance.

नि-ष्कोषितव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a That should
be expelled or taken away.

नि-ष्क्रम (मः) 1.
m. Going out; any
mental faculty, as attention;
degradation, inferiority.

नि-ष्क्रिय (यः-या-यं)
a. Idle; neglect-
ing works.
n. Supreme Being.

निष्ट्या (ष्ट्यः) 1.
m. One from the out-
cast or barbarous tribes.

नि-ष्ठ (ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
a. Staying in, abid-
ing; believing.
f. The catastro-
phe of a drama; end; loss;
completion; profession; firm be-
lief; state; begging; good con-
duct; fixed time of trouble.

नि-ष्णात (तः-ता-तं)
a. Skilful, learn-
ed in; perfect; agreed upon.

नि-ष्पत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
f. Completion, con-
clusion; birth; going out.

नि-स्पन्द (न्दः) 1.
m. Agitation; throb-
bing.
a. Still, immoveable.

नि-ष्पन्न (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
a. Done, com-
pleted; produced; motionless.

नि-ष्पाद्य (द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
a. That should
be done or effected.

नि-ष्पाव (वः) 1.
m. Winnowing;
wind; straw; a pod; pulse.
a.
Certain, positive, indubitable.

नि-ष्पुरुष (षः-षा-षं)
a. Neuter (gen-
der).
m. A eunuch; a coward.

नि-ष्पृह (हः-हा-हं)
a. Content, not
coveting.
f. A plant.

नि-ष्प्रत्यूह (हः-हा-हं)
a. Unimpeded.
n. Freely, without hindrance.

नि-ष्प्रवाण (णः-णा-णं)
a. New and un-
bleached cloth. Also निष्प्रवाणि.

नि-ष्फल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Barren; impo-
tent.
f. Woman past child-bearing.

नि-सर्ग (र्गः) 1.
m. Natural state or
condition, nature; form; crea-
tion; leaving; barter.

नि-सिन्धु (न्धुः) 2.
m. A shrub (Vitex
negundo). Also निसिन्ध.

नि-सृष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
a. Delivered, de-
posited; centrical, middle.

नि-सृष्टा-र्थ (र्थः) 1.
m. A spy; an envoy.

नि-स्तरण (णं) 1.
n. Crossing over;
going out, extraction; means of
success, an expedient.

नि-स्तब्ध (ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
a. Fixed, stop-
ped; paralysed, benumbed.

नि-स्तार (रः) 1.
m. Crossing; escap-
ing; liberation; means.

नि-स्तार-वीज (जं) 1.
n. Cause of li-
beration, as faith, &c.

नि-स्तितीर्षत् (र्षन्-र्षन्ती-र्षत्)
a. Desir-
ous of liberation, seeking it.

नि-स्तुषित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Left, desert-
ed; skinned^1, peeled, pared.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

नि-स्तेजस् (जाः-जाः-जः)
a. Dull, ob-
scure; spiritless; impotent.

नि-स्त्रिंश (शः) 1.
m. A scimitar, or
knife.
a. Merciless, unfeeling.

नि-स्त्रैगुण्य (ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
a. Without the
qualities of truth, passion and
darkness.

नि-स्नाव (वः) 1.
m. What is left after a sale.

नि-स्राव (वः) 1.
m. The scum of rice.

नी-शार (रः) 1.
m. A blanket; cur-
tains; screen, or outer tent.
